summary.en: In Aichi you take the tests at the driving licence test centre. A guide to the written test in foreign languages is available. A copy of your resident record is, in principle, required when applying (to be checked). Check the eligibility, fees and test steps in the Aichi Prefectural Police guide (PDF) (to be checked).

text.en: A reservation is needed for those taking the ordinary Class I written test who graduated from a designated driving school in another prefecture, or who graduated from one in Aichi and are retaking the test (2nd time on) (to be checked).
